author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-auto-k: Label-free k Selection (γ=0.75) + Balanced Cosine kNN
abstract: Select k ∈ {42,45,48} by a batch-only proxy: choose the smallest k whose BalancedGraph has largest connected component (LCC) fraction ≥ 0.995; otherwise take the k with maximal LCC fraction. Residualization is fixed at γ=0.75 (l2=1e-3). Builds a batch-balanced cosine kNN (binary, equal quotas). Goal: match SOTA performance while automating k.
